location: Western Wyoming Community College Wellness Center Rooms A&B 2500 College Drive
title: The purpose of this meeting is to receive testimony and consider potential legislation related to problem gambling prevention and treatment, the Wyoming Gaming Commission's statutory authority, online casinos and sweepstakes, charitable raffles and drawings, skill-based amusement gaming, and pari-mutuel wagering. The Committee will review policy options and determine whether legislation should be advanced for sponsorship.
